title: Make ordinary policy settings a normal Save operation
outcome: Routine settings changes use Save/Cancel, without a second confirmation checkbox or generic administrative ceremony.
acceptance: TermAl removes redundant confirmation steps for ordinary policy edits; any warning is specific to an actual reduction in enforcement and does not demand justification text.
Tests cover save, cancel, concurrent-change refusal and failed save without losing edits; existing authorization, CAS and retry protections remain.
disposal_reason: Carried by TermAl, not done in Engram. Engram's part is delivered (w-a562563fed5c: policy setters need no reason; the receipt returns previous and new policy). The remaining criteria are TermAl's settings form and are carried by TermAl w-478c8a2dcc87 (P2), filed by Termal::Fable2 at Engram::Fable's request (mailbox-ebe242f7 #351, #352, 2026-09-30T22:30Z): a 409 keeps the operator's edits; the reduction warning is computed from the receipt; plain Save and Cancel; and closing TermAl w-e4a5b3186aa0 and w-1887d5476ed7.
